items.label: NVDA
items.detail: Base-case 12-mo fair value ~$300 (≈40% upside) vs $215.38 spot; forward ~26x FY27E / ~20x FY28E EPS for a 50%+ grower with 71% margins and $72B net cash.

items.label: Currency
items.detail: Primary reporting currency is US dollars per NVIDIA's audited 10-K/10-Q filings and investor materials.

items.label: Catalyst
items.detail: Q2 FY2027 earnings print lands Aug 26, 2026 (3 days out); Street models ~$93B revenue, options price ~39% annualized IV — binary near-term risk.

items.label: Fundamentals
items.detail: FY26 revenue $215.9B (+65%), net income $120.1B, GAAP EPS $4.90; Q1 FY27 revenue $81.6B with Data Center +92% YoY to $75.2B.

items.label: Demand
items.detail: Hyperscaler capex ~$690B in 2026 (Amazon $220B, Google ~$200B); management guided Q2 ~$91B with China revenue stripped out entirely.

items.label: Competition
items.detail: Still ~80% AI-accelerator share, but custom ASICs (Broadcom $8.4B/qtr, +106%; $73B backlog) and AMD MI400 (6GW each from OpenAI & Meta) are the structural bear case.

items.label: China
items.detail: H20/H200 export licenses granted but effectively $0 realized China revenue; local rivals (Huawei) filling the gap — upside optionality, not a base-case contributor.

items.label: Valuation
items.detail: $5.2T market cap; trailing 44x GAAP EPS compresses to ~26x FY27E as earnings compound — de-rating risk if AI capex digestion arrives.
